params.1274: You can acquire regular logs from trees using your Woodcutting skill.
params.1275: Click on the logs and select the tinderbox to light them (you should have a tinderbox in your tool belt).
params.1276: Make sure the ground you're standing on is clear enough to light your logs on.
params.2225: You can use raw food on a fire to cook it and make it edible. You also earn Firemaking experience for lighting logs; higher Firemaking lets you light more difficult logs.
